text: Since November 2024, 100% of the shares in AO «Правдинское свино производство» (AO PSP) are held by РБПИ (Таиланд) Компани Лимитед (RBPI (Thailand) Company Limited); the ultimate beneficial owners are not identified in the register.
short: AO PSP is 100% held by a Thai company since November 2024.

source.name: Checko (checko.ru, EGRUL extract): АО «ПСП»
source.quote: РБПИ (ТАИЛАНД) КОМПАНИ ЛИМИТЕД Таиланд Регистрационный номер 0105567081293 с 7 ноября 2024 г. 1 млрд руб. 100%
source.note: Translation: sole shareholder of AO PSP since 7 November 2024 is RBPI (Thailand) Company Limited, registration no. 0105567081293, 100%. EGRUL (Federal Tax Service register) data as displayed by checko.ru; the individuals behind the Thai company are not named.
